verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a SaaS fraud-detection platform that ingests user data. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any way to choose a storage region or residency for data sent to Sift. The docs cover only sending data via REST APIs, backfilling history and sandbox environments; a sandbox is a testing environment, not a storage location.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
